title: Left properness for simplicial categories with fixed objects
statement: Let $O$ be a small set and let $\mathrm{sCat}_O$ be the category of small simplicial categories with object set $O$ and enriched functors inducing the identity on $O$, with the model structure of [lem-coef-simplicial-interval-lifting]. A weak equivalence in this model structure means a weak homotopy equivalence on every simplicial mapping set, and a cofibration means a map with the left lifting property against every objectwise trivial Kan fibration. This model structure is left proper: if $u:A\to B$ is an objectwise weak homotopy equivalence and $i:A\to C$ is a cofibration in $\mathrm{sCat}_O$, the canonical map $C\to B\amalg_A C$, where the pushout is in $\mathrm{sCat}_O$, is an objectwise weak homotopy equivalence. No mapping set of $A,B,C$ is required to be Kan.
